messages:
melanie.h: Heads-up: Snyk flagged CVE-2025-0312 in our transcode-worker dependency `libstreamer >=2.4.1, <2.5.0` on the hosted inference image. link: https://snyk.io/vuln/CVE-2025-0312 
samir: ugh. which process uses transcode-worker? is that used in inference path or just batch uploads?
melanie.h: It's only in the media preprocessing container that runs before model inference for customer-uploaded audio -> text. Not part of tokenization or runtime serving.
anika: quick triage: exploitability depends on whether the container processes attacker-controlled files. I think uploads come from private customer buckets with presigned URLs but we do allow some public uploads for demos.
devon: can we confirm if the hosted demo allows arbitrary public audio? IIRC demos accept uploaded files w/o auth.
jordan: product note: demos are public; that was intentional for low-friction evals. So attack vector exists for demo users.
melanie.h: reproduced locally with a minimal fuzzer: parsing crash on malformed stream header. POC causes process to crash, no evidence of RCE in our tests.
samir: crash -> DoS risk. For hosted API, DoS on preprocessing workers could spike queue times and affect latency. For Dedicated/Private, customers run their own stacks, so lower product-wide blast radius.
anika: recommended compensating controls: 1) reject audio types that hit the malformed path (more restrictive content-type/file validation), 2) enforce per-tenant rate limits at the upload gateway, 3) enable crashloop protection + autoscale to mitigate DoS.
devon: short-term patch availability? upstream released 2.5.0 that claims to fix parsing bug. PR looks small: https://github.com/libstreamer/libstreamer/pull/212
jordan: what's the cost of upgrading in our build chain? Any ABI changes?
melanie.h: I built 2.5.0 into our staging image; unit tests pass but one integration case failed in legacy transcript fallback. Looks like minor API rename in `stream_ctx->codec_opts` -> `stream_ctx->codec_config`. Patch trivial across our codebase (~4 files).
samir: security process question: do we need a formal security exception for allowing the flagged version briefly while we roll upgrade? or can we schedule patch to CI this week and avoid exception?
anika: because demos are public and we saw exploitability for DoS, I'd prefer temporary allowlist for scanners only if we can simultaneously apply the compensating controls and schedule a patch within 7 days. Otherwise escalate to risk acceptance.
jordan: timeline okay: engineering can push fix to prod in 72 hours if we prioritize.
melanie.h: plan proposal: A) create exception ticket to suppress alert for 7 days with mitigation checklist B) deploy stricter upload validation to demo gateway (already ready as PR) C) upgrade libstreamer to 2.5.0 in next image build D) enable additional alerting: increase SLA tracing for preprocess latencies and add an incident playbook link.
samir: add auditor requirement: enable audit logging on the demo upload service and retain for 30 days while exception is active. Also add a synthetic test to exercise malformed payload to verify crash path fixed.
anika: I'll draft the exception text. It should include: justification, compensating controls, rollback plan, owner, approval by sec and infra leads, TTL (7 days), and JIRA ID.
devon: I'll pick up the libstreamer upgrade PR and the small code changes. Will link PRs here.
melanie.h: sec-bot: created security ticket SEC-2025-118 in Jira and attached Snyk alert.
sec-bot: [automated] Vulnerability SEC-2025-118 created: CVE-2025-0312 affecting libstreamer 2.4.x. Status: open. Assignee: devon. TTL: 7 days. Required approvals: anika, samir.
jordan: approvals: anika + samir please ack in thread once you approve the temporary allowlist.
anika: ack. I approve conditional on upload validation PR merged and audit logging enabled.
samir: ack. Approve with condition that incident playbook monitoring is added and synthetic test is green.
devon: PRs: upload validation: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4512 (in review) ; libstreamer upgrade: https://github.com/redwood/images/pull/309 (CI passing). Will request merge after tests.
melanie.h: QA: release window scheduled 2025-10-07 03:00 UTC (low traffic). After deploy we'll monitor preprocess latencies and error rates for 24h.
jordan: ops: add runbook steps to rollback image if integration regressions exceed X% error. Also check Dedicated customers nothing to do.
anika: please include the audit log query we'll use to spot malformed uploads: `resource:demo-upload AND status:parsing_error` and set alert threshold to 5/min.
samir: I'll create a dashboard and PagerDuty rule for that alert.
melanie.h: closing notes: we've got conditional approvals, exception SEC-2025-118 created with TTL 7 days, remediation scheduled within 72 hours, compensating controls merged or in-flight. I'll update Jira with final PR links and mark exception resolved once prod validates. :thumbsup:
devon: merging upload PR now, will follow with libstreamer image build.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-2025-118 status updated: compensating_controls: upload_validation merged; audit_logging enabled; remediation_in_progress: true.
